title: Listening Drill — Restoring a puppet — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Restoring a puppet — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on restoring a puppet last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with loose joints. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: snapped thread.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of joint movement so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow small cloth instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the puppet maker before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Wednesday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
